known_pitfall_claim: The proof claims that the reversed-limit integral from x_{i+1} to x_i equals the positively oriented integral from 0 to h after substituting x=t+x_i.
pitfall_counterexample: Take h=1, x_i=0, x_{i+1}=x_i+h=1, and f(x)=1. All endpoints and the step relation are explicit. The claimed left side is ∫₁⁰ 1 dx=0−1=−1, while the right side is ∫₀¹ f(t+0)dt=∫₀¹1dt=1. Thus −1≠1.
